product.name: Goal-Based Investing
product.description: A service that builds diversified investment portfolios tailored to individual financial goals and risk profiles.

product.name: Automated Investment Management (Robo Advisor)
product.description: An automated investment solution that manages portfolios using technology-driven tools and strategies based on client goals.

product.name: Diversified Portfolio Access
product.description: Provides investors with access to globally diversified portfolios across major asset classes and markets.

product.name: Shariah-Compliant Investment Services
product.description: Investment services that comply with Shariah law and are supervised by the Capital Market Authority of Saudi Arabia.

product.name: Subscription-Based Fee Structure
product.description: A transparent subscription fee model for investment services, replacing traditional commission-based fees.

product.name: Madkhol Premium
product.description: A Madkhol Capital service offering access to over 5,000 global funds and advanced portfolio-building tools.
